# Hmimi Chioukh — AI Product Designer

## About
Hmimi Chioukh is an AI Product Designer based in Algeria, specializing in building scalable SaaS platforms and digital experiences. Expertise spans UI/UX design, user research, design systems, and AI-powered product design.

## Services
- SaaS Product Design (0→1 and iteration)
- UI/UX Design & Prototyping
- User Research & Usability Testing
- Design Systems & Component Libraries
- AI Interface Design
- Frontend Development (React, Tailwind CSS)

## Case Studies
- DadyCar: Fleet management SaaS platform
- FocusCare: Healthcare SaaS platform
- Shihany: Business management platform
- Resaglob: Global business platform

## Blog

- Vehicle monitoring UX improvements
